provider.name: Selectel
provider.summary: A Russian cloud (St Petersburg). The GPU page prices cloud servers by the hour in roubles, each rate printed as a "from" figure for the configuration the card describes - extras are added on top. Only those cloud-server cards are read here: the same page also prices managed Kubernetes node groups and dedicated servers by the month, which are different products. Each card shows the machine with the lowest price per GPU. The dollar figure uses the Bank of Russia's official rate of the day.
provider.notes: RUB listing, scope advertised_from (every rate is printed "От"). Only the hourly cloud-server cards are read: the same page prices managed Kubernetes node groups at their own rate and dedicated servers per month, and neither is this product - that is what two cards printing 579,94 and 509,10 for one 2x RTX PRO 6000 turned out to be. instance is the link's flavor id, region the pool it opens (ru-6). One quote per card, the lowest price per GPU, per node with the count from the GPU row. "RTX PRO 6000 (96 ГБ)" and "RTX 6000 PRO (96 ГБ)" are two spellings of one card (flavor 13980); bare "H200" is the neutral h200. The server sends no charset, so the page is decoded as UTF-8 explicitly. VAT: the page says nothing about it for these rates
